description:
Zebra stripes aren't decoration — they're a built-in fly shield. Scientists found biting flies can't land on zebras: the stripes mess with their vision so they fail to slow down and bounce right off.
Since these biting flies carry deadly diseases, those black-and-white stripes are literally life-saving armor. No two zebras share the same pattern — it's nature's barcode.
